final_report.root_cause: INCONCLUSIVE — Tracing shows repeated ECONNREFUSED / gRPC UNAVAILABLE errors (connections to 10.96.80.21:8080 and 10.96.193.65:8080) but pod- and service-level checks for the currently running frontend and recommendation pods/services show healthy processes and different ClusterIPs/endpoints. The investigation so far rules out the specific frontend pod (frontend-559ccb996b-9gbnn), the visible frontend-proxy pod checked, and the recommendation service as being currently down or configured to listen on the wrong port. The most likely remaining causes are: (a) transient network or kube-proxy/iptables forwarding issues causing packets to be rejected, (b) callers using stale/incorrect IP addresses (requests routed to old/deleted pod or service IPs), or (c) another proxy/instance (not the proxy pod whose logs were inspected) attempting to reach those IPs. Current evidence is insufficient to definitively prove which of these caused the incident or to localize it to a single component.
final_report.evidence_summary: 1) Traces (multiple traceIDs) show repeated connection failures: ECONNREFUSED to 10.96.80.21:8080 and gRPC UNAVAILABLE to 10.96.193.65:8080, originating from frontend-proxy / frontend. 2) Priority-1 checks: frontend-559ccb996b-9gbnn is Running, Ready, with 0 restarts and application logs show successful HTTP 200 responses and 'Order placed successfully' messages — no listen/bind/readiness errors. 3) Priority-2 checks: frontend Service currently maps to endpoints 10.244.1.17:8080 and ClusterIP 10.96.127.67; the inspected frontend-proxy pod logs show Envoy startup but no outbound attempts to 10.96.80.21:8080. 4) Priority-3 checks: frontend logs show successful /api/recommendations calls (HTTP 200) and recommendation Service endpoints/ClusterIP differ from the IP observed in traces. Collectively these show a mismatch between the IPs in traces and the current cluster service/pod IPs, and they disprove the hypotheses that the checked frontend pod or the inspected recommendation pods were simply not listening on :8080.
final_report.investigation_summary: Completed investigations (priorities 1-3): verified frontend pod health and logs (priority 1), inspected frontend-proxy pod logs and frontend Service endpoint mapping (priority 2), and verified frontend-to-recommendation connectivity and recommendation Service endpoints (priority 3).
